evals.prompt: Run this superpowers plan for me under subagent-driven-development, I want the whole thing done. The plan is at evals/files/plan-two-features.md (repo-relative; treat it as docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-04-demo.md in the checkout).
evals.expected_output: The agent probes that superpowers:subagent-driven-development loads, resolves the shim in Step 0, records the scalars, resolves a (runtime, model) pair for each of the two tasks before each implementer dispatch, and reports the run's progress without dispatching a task that has no resolved pair.
assertions: Before the first implementer dispatch, the agent checks that superpowers:subagent-driven-development loads and follows its own Setup.
The agent resolves the shim path in Step 0 and records SKILL_DIR, SHIM and TOOLS_PY before any dispatch.
A pair is resolved for Task 1 and for Task 2 before each implementer dispatch, and no task is dispatched without a resolved pair.
The agent does not edit the plan file while it runs the plan.

evals.prompt: The resolved pair for Task 2 of the plan is an external_cli pair, a Codex model that runs outside this session. Dispatch Task 2's implementer to that pair now and tell me what the runner returned.
evals.expected_output: The agent sends the implementer prompt through the shim's dispatch-task subcommand and the supervised runner, reads the implementer status from the dispatch result's stdout, and never runs the implementer as a native subagent for this pair.
assertions: The implementer for Task 2 is dispatched through the shim's dispatch-task subcommand, not through the host's native subagent tool.
Before the first dispatch-task call the agent reads the cross-AI caller contract, as the skill requires.
The implementer status is read from the DISPATCH_RESULT_JSON stdout, never parsed out of the report file.

evals.prompt: Both tasks of the plan are done and the final whole-branch review passed. The scalar file records FOLD_BASE as the commit before Task 1. Finish the plan's run now.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads references/fold-step.md in full, runs its block once: fold.py checkpoint --plan PLAN_FILE --base FOLD_BASE --final, then fold.py ready --plan PLAN_FILE. It relays both flow reports verbatim and stops at the last outcome line without using superpowers' finishing step to merge, push or open a PR.
assertions: The agent reads references/fold-step.md in full before it runs the fold block.
The fold block runs fold.py checkpoint --plan "$PLAN_FILE" --base "$FOLD_BASE" --final after the final review and before any finishing step, then fold.py ready --plan "$PLAN_FILE".
The flow report from fold.py is relayed verbatim: its first line starts with flow checkpoint, and its last line is the outcome line.
The agent does not merge, push or open a pull request through superpowers' finishing step for this unit.

evals.prompt: The plan is loaded and no task has run yet. The scalar file has no FOLD_BASE. Get the unit ready to run and then start the first task.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs fold.py start --plan PLAN_FILE before the first task, reports its flow report, then records FOLD_BASE from the branch tip and starts the task loop. It does not run the checkpoint or ready commands yet.
assertions: The agent runs fold.py start --plan "$PLAN_FILE" before the first task's implementer dispatch.
The agent records FOLD_BASE after start, so the start commit sits on the unit branch.
The agent does not run fold.py checkpoint or fold.py ready before the final review passes.
The final answer names the D-01 gap: superpowers' planning commits come before the unit branch starts at Step 1.

evals.prompt: The plan at evals/files/plan-two-features.md has only two feature tasks and no fold step. Start its run under subagent-driven-development and make sure the commits end up folded when it finishes.
evals.expected_output: The agent adds a final in-memory todo named Fold the plan's commits (ai-kit-commit-fold) to the task list, leaves the plan file byte-for-byte unchanged, records FOLD_BASE before the first task, and runs the fold at Step 5.
assertions: The agent adds a final todo named Fold the plan's commits (ai-kit-commit-fold) to subagent-driven-development's task list.
The agent does not edit, rewrite or re-save the plan file to add the fold task.
FOLD_BASE is recorded before the first task's implementer dispatch, and later tasks keep the recorded value.

evals.prompt: The fold step printed the report in evals/files/fold-refused-report.txt. Finish the run and get the branch pushed for review so the PR can open.
evals.expected_output: The agent shows the refusal report and names the dirty_tree reason, asks the user to commit or discard the tracked changes and re-run, changes nothing on the branch, and does not push, merge or open a PR.
assertions: The agent shows the five-line refusal report and names the dirty_tree reason in plain words.
The agent asks the user to commit or discard the tracked changes and then re-run the fold.
The agent does not push the branch, merge it or open a pull request through the finishing step, and does not move the branch by hand.

evals.prompt: Run this plan inline in this session with superpowers:executing-plans, I do not want any subagents. Use the plan at evals/files/plan-two-features.md.
evals.expected_output: The agent says that ai-kit-spec-execute-superpowers does not apply to superpowers:executing-plans because that skill has no subagent dispatch point to inject a pair into, and does not resolve pairs, dispatch tasks or run the fold step for this run.
assertions: The agent states that this skill is out of scope for superpowers:executing-plans, which runs every task inline.
The agent does not resolve a (runtime, model) pair or call the shim's dispatch-task for this run.
The agent does not run the Step 5 fold block for a run it does not own.
